title: Terrible Material
text: Terrible Material. These sheets are terrible. I have a 13.5 inch deep mattress and these just flop all over. Being satin you can't tuck the excess under the mattress because it slips right out again. Speaking of the satin; these manage to somehow be slippery without being silky. There's a distinct plastic feel to the sheets. They're slippery without being soft. The material is also very thin. I was able to clearly see my television through the top sheet. I would not recommend these to anyone.

description: Enjoy a luxuriously smooth slumber with this complete set of satin sheets for Queen beds in a fashionable solid black hue. This set includes one flat sheet, one fitted sheet, and two standard-sized pillow cases. These shiny, silky sheets have a sublimely smooth touch to the hand, and they're made of 100 percent woven polyester satin. The fitted sheet has elastic all the way around, and it offers a pocket depth of 14 inches that will accommodate mattresses up to 17 inches deep. Both the flat sheet and the pillowcases have a 4-inch hem. Machine wash and tumble dry on the gentle setting.
